text_inputs.tags: Sleek alt-pop with a tight 104 BPM pulse, sub-bass and clipped 808 support under glassy synth layers, muted guitar sparks, and wide impact transitions that bloom into the hook. The lead vocal should feel close and fast-breathing in the verses, then open into stacked harmonies and chant doubles in the chorus while the groove keeps a restless bounce with slight push on the downbeat.
text_inputs.lyrics:
[Intro - sparse, atmospheric, low-register hush]
Wet signs flicker
Cold mist, blue chrome
Your shadow cuts first

[Verse 1 - cinematic detail, tight cadence, nocturnal motion]
Sneakers hiss on the crosswalk paint
Taxi spray hits the hem of my jeans
Your laugh jumps loose from the station gate
Streetlamp gold in the smoke between

[Pre-Chorus - lifted, intimate, breath-spaced]
You move closer, the whole block sways
Rain on your wrist, heat through the gray
One more second and the sky gives way

[Chorus - anthemic, chant-ready, bright release]
Neon rain rush on my skin
Red light flashing, pull me in
Neon rain rush, run with it, run with it
Your name sparks white on the window tint
City keeps spinning, we don't give in

[Post-Chorus - echo hook, clipped callback]
Neon rain rush
Run with it
On my skin

[Verse 2 - forward-driving, sharper imagery, scene advancement]
Now we're half soaked under the market awning
Steam rolls up from the late-night grills
You steal my ring, draw a heart in the fog there
Train brakes scream and the whole glass thrills

[Pre-Chorus 2 - wider vowels, suspended tension]
Your wet hair dark by the candy light
My pulse kicks hard when you lock your eyes
Say go, and the storm turns bright

[Chorus 2 - anthemic return with fresh support lines]
Neon rain rush on my skin
Blue sparks falling, pull me in
Neon rain rush, run with it, run with it
Heartbeat drumming through the billboard wind
Street keeps roaring, we don't give in

[Bridge - stripped, reflective pivot, thinner language]
When the last train leaves, will the glow stay warm
If the signs go black, do we fade or burn
You press my hand like an answer first

[Final Chorus - largest payoff, expanded harmonies, emotional release]
Neon rain rush on my skin
All this bright wreckage pulls me in
Neon rain rush, run with it, run with it
We break the dawn in the drugstore glass
Your smile hits gold and the storm rolls past
City still spinning, but we finally land

[Outro - afterglow, soft comedown, lingering image]
Neon rain on the hood
Daybreak in your eyes
Run with it
